items.t: The Latest: Israelis vote in a tense election seen as a referendum on Netanyahu
items.x: Israelis were voting Tuesday in a tense national election widely seen as a referendum on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's leadership since the Hamas-led Oct. 7, 2023, attack on Israel and the wars that have since shaken the Middle East.

items.t: 2 men charged with UK national security offenses over incident at US-run military base in England
items.x: Two men were charged Tuesday with national security offenses over a suspected plot against RAF Fairford, a U.S.-run military air base in England, police and prosecutors said.
